# Game Idea: Canvas Asteroid Dodger

A minimalist top‑down HTML canvas game where the player controls a spaceship navigating an endless field of moving asteroids. The ship can rotate and thrust using arrow keys. Asteroids drift in random directions and speeds. The player must avoid collisions; touching any asteroid ends the game (lose condition). A timer counts how long the player survives, encouraging high‑score runs. Simple graphics, physics, and a single lose condition keep implementation lightweight.

1: // Minimal Asteroid Dodger game
2: // Canvas with id="game"
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas element #game not found');
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   // Set background color
8:   ctx.fillStyle = 'black';
9: 
10:   // Audio setup
11:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
12:   function playTone(freq, duration) {
13:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
14:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
15:     osc.type = 'sine';
16:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
17:     osc.connect(gain);
18:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
19:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime);
20:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.01);
21:     osc.start();
22:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
23:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
24:   }
25:   function playThrust() { playTone(400, 0.1); }
26:   function playCrash() { playTone(100, 0.5); }
27:   canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
28:   canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
29: 
30:   // Create starfield background
31:   const stars = [];
32:   const starCount = 100;
33:   for (let i = 0; i < starCount; i++) {
34:     stars.push({
35:       x: Math.random() * canvas.width,
36:       y: Math.random() * canvas.height,
37:       radius: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
38:       alpha: Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.5,
39:     });
40:   }
41: 
42:   const keys = {};
43:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => (keys[e.key] = true));
44:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.key] = false));
45: 
46:   class Ship {
47:     constructor() {
48:       this.x = canvas.width / 2;
49:       this.y = canvas.height / 2;
50:       this.angle = 0; // radians
51:       this.radius = 10;
52:     }
53:     update(dt) {
54:       // rotation
55:       if (keys['ArrowLeft']) this.angle -= 3 * dt;
56:       if (keys['ArrowRight']) this.angle += 3 * dt;
57:       // thrust
58:       const thrust = 200; // pixels per second squared
59:       if (keys['ArrowUp']) {
60:         this.x += Math.cos(this.angle) * thrust * dt;
61:         this.y += Math.sin(this.angle) * thrust * dt;
62:         // play thrust sound
63:         playThrust();
64:       }
65:       // keep within bounds (wrap around)
66:       if (this.x < 0) this.x += canvas.width;
67:       if (this.x > canvas.width) this.x -= canvas.width;
68:       if (this.y < 0) this.y += canvas.height;
69:       if (this.y > canvas.height) this.y -= canvas.height;
70:     }
71:     draw() {
72:       ctx.save();
73:       ctx.translate(this.x, this.y);
74:       ctx.rotate(this.angle);
75:       ctx.beginPath();
76:       ctx.moveTo(15, 0);
77:       ctx.lineTo(-10, -8);
78:       ctx.lineTo(-10, 8);
79:       ctx.closePath();
80:       // Gradient for ship hull
81:       const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(-15, 0, 15, 0);
82:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#8fbfff');
83:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#ffffff');
84:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
85:       ctx.fill();
86:       ctx.strokeStyle = '#cce6ff';
87:       ctx.lineWidth = 0.5;
88:       ctx.stroke();
89:       ctx.restore();
90:     }
91:   }
92: 
93:   class Asteroid {
94:     constructor() {
95:       // spawn at random edge
96:       const edge = Math.floor(Math.random() * 4);
97:       if (edge === 0) { this.x = 0; this.y = Math.random() * canvas.height; }
98:       else if (edge === 1) { this.x = canvas.width; this.y = Math.random() * canvas.height; }
99:       else if (edge === 2) { this.x = Math.random() * canvas.width; this.y = 0; }
100:       else { this.x = Math.random() * canvas.width; this.y = canvas.height; }
101:       const speed = 50 + Math.random() * 100;
102:       const dir = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
103:       this.vx = Math.cos(dir) * speed;
104:       this.vy = Math.sin(dir) * speed;
105:       this.radius = 15 + Math.random() * 20;
106:     }
107:     update(dt) {
108:       this.x += this.vx * dt;
109:       this.y += this.vy * dt;
110:       // wrap
111:       if (this.x < -this.radius) this.x = canvas.width + this.radius;
112:       if (this.x > canvas.width + this.radius) this.x = -this.radius;
113:       if (this.y < -this.radius) this.y = canvas.height + this.radius;
114:       if (this.y > canvas.height + this.radius) this.y = -this.radius;
115:     }
116:     draw() {
117:       // Asteroid gradient fill
118:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
119:         this.x, this.y, this.radius * 0.2,
120:         this.x, this.y, this.radius
121:       );
122:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#555555');
123:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#aaaaaa');
124:       ctx.beginPath();
125:       ctx.arc(this.x, this.y, this.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
126:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
127:       ctx.fill();
128:       ctx.strokeStyle = '#777777';
129:       ctx.lineWidth = 1;
130:       ctx.stroke();
131:     }
132:   }
133: 
134:   const ship = new Ship();
135:   const asteroids = [];
136:   let lastTime = performance.now();
137:   let spawnTimer = 0;
138:   let survived = 0;
139:   let gameOver = false;
140: 
141:   function spawnAsteroid() {
142:     asteroids.push(new Asteroid());
143:   }
144: 
145:   function checkCollision() {
146:     for (const a of asteroids) {
147:       const dx = a.x - ship.x;
148:       const dy = a.y - ship.y;
149:       const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
150:       if (dist < a.radius + ship.radius) return true;
151:     }
152:     return false;
153:   }
154: 
155:   function loop(now) {
156:     const dt = (now - lastTime) / 1000;
157:     lastTime = now;
158:     if (!gameOver) {
159:       survived += dt;
160:       // spawn every 1.5 seconds
161:       spawnTimer += dt;
162:       if (spawnTimer > 1.5) { spawnTimer = 0; spawnAsteroid(); }
163:       ship.update(dt);
164:       for (const a of asteroids) a.update(dt);
165:         if (checkCollision()) {
166:           playCrash();
167:           gameOver = true;
168:         }
169:     }
170:     // render
171:     // Clear and draw background
172:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
173:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
174:     // Draw stars
175:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,1)';
176:     for (const s of stars) {
177:       ctx.globalAlpha = s.alpha;
178:       ctx.beginPath();
179:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
180:       ctx.fill();
181:     }
182:     ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
183:     ship.draw();
184:     for (const a of asteroids) a.draw();
185:     // UI
186:     ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
187:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
188:     ctx.fillText(`Time: ${survived.toFixed(2)}s`, 10, 20);
189:     if (gameOver) {
190:       ctx.fillStyle = 'red';
191:       ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
192:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2 - 120, canvas.height / 2);
193:     }
194:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
195:   }
196: 
197:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
198: })();

(End of file - total 198 lines)
</content>
